_provenance.description: CrPC (1973) to BNSS (2023) section concordance table
_provenance.source: Comparative Table of CrPC 1973 & BNSS 2023, compiled by Adv. Gurender Rana / Rathee & Associates for the Dwarka Court Bar Association
_provenance.caveat: This is a practitioner-compiled comparative table, not the raw MHA/Gazette comparative statement itself. Cross-checked internally for consistency (total CrPC section count tops out at 484 'Repeal and savings', matching the real Act; BNSS tops out at 531, matching the real Act) but NOT independently verified section-by-section against the primary source. Recommend a final spot-check against the official MHA comparative statement or IndiaCode before treating this as unconditionally authoritative for production use, per project policy on legal-data verification.
_provenance.note_on_112_113: BNSS sections 112 and 113 appear TWICE in the source table - once as a forward-reference placeholder (annotated 'See Section 166A/166B Cr.P.C') positioned where the 105-series sections would otherwise expect a match, and once correctly paired with CrPC 166A/166B later in the document (BNSS relocated this content earlier in its own numbering than CrPC's). The duplicate placeholder listing has been dropped from 'new_in_bnss_no_crpc_predecessor' - both sections DO have a CrPC predecessor.
_provenance.no_crpc_parser_exists_yet: Unlike IPC_TO_BNS, this table isn't currently wired into any parser (no corpus/parsers/crpc.py exists in this codebase). Stored here so it's ready when/if one is built.
